items.title: Sudan army drone strike kills 35 at Darfur court, rights group says
items.description: The Sudanese army struck a traditional court in a Rapid Support Forces-held village in North Darfur with drones on Sunday, killing 35 people, a rights group said. Emergency Lawyers said the attack hit Garra al Zawaya as civilians gathered for local court hearings, wounding several others during the afternoon strike.

items.title: General Staff of AFU Reports 207 Combat Clashes in 24 Hours
items.description: The General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine (AFU) reported 207 combat clashes over a 24-hour period on Friday, July 31, reporting heaviest fighting near Pokrovsk, where the AFU repelled 28 enemy attacks. Russian forces carried out 55 airstrikes and nearly 2,000 shellings nationwide.
